01 Feed — Visualisation

Tag distribution and package relation networks.

The statistics below are precomputed by the server, stored inside the JSql database and streamed to this page as json. Tags drive the word cloud, a periodic analysis embeds the package tag matrix into three dimensions and clusters it, while the nuspec dependency graph reveals how the hosted packages depend on each other.

04 Package Clusters

UMAP 3D · KMeans click a point to open the package · all packages
loading cluster scatter…
Every point is one package: its tag set is encoded as a 0/1 vector, embedded into three dimensions with UMAP and classified with KMeans. The colour encodes the cluster label, the point size reflects the cluster size, and dragging / scrolling orbits the static embedding.

loading dependency network…
Green nodes are packages hosted in this feed, blue nodes are external dependencies that were not uploaded here. An arrow points from a package to the package it depends on.
